stories.summary: Luigi Mangione pleaded guilty in federal court on Friday, admitting that he shot and killed UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson on the streets of Manhattan on December 4, 2024. The murder was astonishingly brazen. In case anyone has forgotten, Mangione followed Thompson, shot him from behind at point-blank range, then fled the scene, only to be caught in a Pennsylvania McDonald’s five days later.
